move.subject: Seal 24 mm: full allocation against a firm two-year commitment
move.body:
Dear Ms Zellner,

Thank you for your quotation. We would like to propose a reciprocal trade.

On delivery, we can agree to 54 days instead of the 42-day standard lead time recorded in our framework agreement (ctr:4600070410#5.1). Your capacity letter of 18 September says you will prioritise firm, long-term commitments (doc:20260918-70410-P10). We therefore offer a binding commitment of 23,400 pieces in each year of a 24-month contract. In return, we ask for full allocation of that volume at EUR 29.89/unit, DAP, 30 days net, effective 2027-01-01.

Our buyer estimate is EUR 24.31/unit excluding margin, with 5% uncertainty (cost:340010); it is a buyer benchmark, not your disclosed cost.

Does this trade work for you?

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We note your proposal for a 24-month commitment at 23,400 units per year. 

Accordingly, we can offer EUR 31.70 per unit under these revised terms. The full details of our offer are a price of €31.70 per unit, Lieferzeit 54 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, a contract term of 24 months.

This offer is valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

move.subject: Three-year package for the 24 mm mechanical seal
move.body:
Dear Ms Zellner,

Thank you for moving to EUR 31.70 and offering the full 23,400 pieces per year.

We would like to answer with a larger package: EUR 31.00/unit, 23,400 pieces binding in each year, now over 36 months, with 54 days' lead time rather than the 42-day standard in our framework agreement (ctr:4600070410#5.1). DAP, 30 days net and effective 2027-01-01 remain unchanged. We move up from EUR 29.89 and add a third committed year, which is the firm, long-term commitment your capacity letter of 18 September describes (doc:20260918-70410-P10).

Our March annual-review note records that price changes above 2% required pricing-committee approval (doc:20260310-70410-M1). The complete historical meeting note is attached for your review.

Please present this complete three-year package to the pricing committee for approval at EUR 31.00, with you remaining our lead. If that process has changed, please confirm who can approve this complete package.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

Dear Sir or Madam,

We note your proposal for a 36-month term and confirm that I hold the authority to approve this agreement. In exchange for the extended contract duration, we can offer a revised price of EUR 31.50 per unit.

Our current offer comprises a price of €31.50 per unit, Lieferzeit 54 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, and a contract term of 36 months. This offer remains valid for 7 days. This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide.

Please provide the exact figures supporting your claims regarding approval thresholds, as we require verified data. Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal. We are happy to discuss this in a call; until then our offer stands.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH
